A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GEDI study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and matching appendices support reliable comparison. The substantive appendices A–N in v3 correspond to B–O in v4 despite extensive reformatting.

before.justification: v3 reports original synthetic-data experiments, image clustering and generation results, OOD evaluations, and MNIST addition experiments, including appendix results.

after.justification: v4 retains original results for these experiments in Tables 2–6 and 10–12 and the accompanying figures, although one comparator's results are removed.

M1.justification: GEDI's three-term objective, energy-model construction, SGLD/Adam training in Algorithm 1, and neuro-symbolic loss substitution remain unchanged. The revised representation definition in Section 2 does not establish a change to the implemented architecture or procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate moons, circles, SVHN, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and MNIST addition. Clustering, generation, linear probing, cross-dataset OOD detection, and the different addition-data sizes retain the same coverage.

E2.justification: v4 removes the GEDI two-stage comparator from Tables 4, 5, and 10–12. JEM, Barlow Twins, SwAV, and the retained GEDI variants remain. This is a reduction by one comparison method across the real-world evaluations; Section 6 still mentions the removed comparator.

E3.justification: The retained experiments use the same architectures, training budgets, batch sizes, augmentations, metrics, linear-probe procedure, and MNIST sampling protocol. Tables 7–9 and the corresponding experimental descriptions retain their settings.

E4.justification: The loss-component ablations, failure-mode visualizations, loss-weight sensitivity analysis in Figure 8, and neuro-symbolic comparisons in Table 6 and Figure 11 are retained. No analysis question or robustness scenario is added or removed.

E5.justification: Five-run or five-seed reporting, mean and standard-deviation summaries, and Table 6's median and standard-deviation reporting remain unchanged. Removing uncertainty-bearing entries for the two-stage comparator does not introduce a different statistical reporting practice.

E6.justification: The two-stage comparator's NMI, FID, linear-probe accuracy, and OOD results disappear from Tables 4, 5, and 10–12. For example, Table 5 removes its AUROCs of 0.94 and 0.93, while GEDI remains at 0.80 for both tests. Retained numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: The contrastive derivation gains missing logarithms and corrects Equation 13 from subtracting KL(model||data) to adding KL(data||model), in v3 Appendix A versus v4 Appendix B. Section 2 also changes the representation codomain from a hypersphere to R^l and corrects the similarity-function signature and a product index. These are localized revisions within retained theory.

C1.justification: The introduction withdraws the explicit claimed clustering gains of 4, 2, and 22 percentage points on SVHN, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100, replacing them with an unquantified improvement claim. The unification, failure-mode guarantees, and neuro-symbolic contributions remain.

C2.justification: The explanations of loss behavior, backbone-size effects, generative benefits, and neuro-symbolic grounding remain. Both versions retain limitations concerning known class counts and priors, larger-scale evaluation, and unsuccessful OOD separation when training on CIFAR datasets.

D1.justification: Architecture and hyperparameter disclosures in Tables 7–9, implementation-source descriptions, and MNIST data-generation instructions are retained. Both versions state that the code will be released upon acceptance; no new access information is supplied.

R1.justification: The introduction removes the citation to Sansone (2023) when introducing the triad of failure modes, reducing that explicit attribution. The related-work discussion and bibliography otherwise retain the same works and positioning.

P1.justification: Most prose and the main section sequence remain intact. References move before the appendices, acknowledgments and author-contribution text disappear, and numbering changes. Several references become stale: for example, v4 Theorem 1 still cites Definitions 12–14 although the failure modes are now Definitions 8–10.

P2.justification: The document is re-typeset throughout with different fonts, text widths, headings, headers, and figure/table placement. Figures 3 and 4 now share a page, and Tables 4, 5, and 10–12 lose comparator rows or columns and change formatting. All eleven figures are retained without new graphical evidence.

improvement.justification: v4 usefully corrects the contrastive proof, but removes a directly relevant hybrid comparator, including Table 5's AUROCs of 0.94/0.93 versus GEDI's unchanged 0.80, while Section 6 still claims that comparison. Renumbering also introduces incorrect hypothesis references. The reduced comparative completeness and consistency outweigh the localized mathematical repairs, producing a limited overall decline.
